title: EVALUATING SIMPLE DEBIASING TECHNIQUES IN ROBERTA-BASED HATE SPEECH DETECTION MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating hate speech detection models by augmenting the Founta dataset with African American English (AAE) and White-Aligned English (WAE) dialect labels using a demographic-based classifier, and measuring disparities using per-class false positive rates (FPR), Parity Gap, and Equality Gap across the dialect subgroups.
